// request.userId -> input.inputs[opaque/~0] -> query.parameters[user-id]

// query.results[amount] + query.results[tax] -> response.total (aggregate).
// A branch can copy query.results[amount] to response.total independently.
// A generic constant populates response.kind; no literal secret is retained.
// response.total -> query.results[amount] models an explicit source cycle.
// response.total and request.userId feed an unknown transform to response.token.
// The transform is redacted; all described inputs remain visible.
